firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently watered a plant goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the Greenhouse. They begin by choosing and placing a Shrub tile; the group then contributes clues and guesses.
At the end of a continuing turn, replenish and pass the Greenhouse to the player on the left, who becomes the active player.
The two-player rules and Expert variation change other parts of play or setup, while retaining this starting-player criterion.
